scenarios.title: A creature spell with flash can be cast at instant timing, one without it cannot

setup.notes: Player B has priority after A passes in A's beginning of combat step, with an empty stack.

decisions: B, holding priority in A's beginning of combat step, checks whether the creature card in hand can be cast.

variants.label: flash_creature
variants.expected: Casting Ashcoat Bear (flash) is legal for B: can_play is true. It can be paid with the two Forests.

variants.label: no_flash_creature
variants.delta: B's hand holds Grizzly Bears (no flash) instead of Ashcoat Bear.
variants.expected: Casting Grizzly Bears is illegal for B in A's beginning of combat step: can_play is false.

variants.label: flash_with_spell_on_stack
variants.delta: Shock controlled by A targeting B is on the stack when B receives priority, and B's hand holds Ashcoat Bear.
variants.expected: Casting Ashcoat Bear in response to Shock is legal for B: can_play is true.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the flash_with_spell_on_stack variant, put Shock on the stack as {"card": "Shock", "controller": "A", "targets": ["B"]}; A's battlefield otherwise holds a Mountain tapped for it.
